reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in Imma (No. 74) to an ordered, fully occupied 28-atom conventional cell, Ti4 Cu4 Mo4 Se16 (TiCuMoSe4, Z=4), with a=7.59192, b=7.79619, c=10.85920 angstrom; primitive reduction only halves the I-centered cell and does not create a distinct realization. The indexed Imma cell accounts for the strong and weak reflections across 5-90 degrees with a reported peak-position RMS of about 0.0074 degrees and no important unexplained reflection. Crucially, the submitted atomic model was instantiated and its five symmetry-allowed coordinate parameters were refined against the whole profile: the trace reports correlation 0.9898 and normalized RMS 0.1401. A blind recheck with an optimized global line shape gives correlation 0.9926 and normalized RMS 0.1193, close to a free-reflection-intensity profile floor of 0.0972; all five alternative cation-site permutations are materially worse (0.1733-0.3472), consistent with the trace's refined Cu/Ti-inverted result of 0.1713. Complete periodic shells are coherent CuSe4, TiSe6, and MoSe6 polyhedra (2.49-2.64 angstrom) with no short overlaps or occupancy/stoichiometry failure. Thus the explicit ordered realization has convergent diffraction and chemistry support, and no concrete incompatible branch remains viable enough to justify another attempt.
